records.symptom: Control+Return emits no bytes in legacy mode or a modified-key sequence not bound to newline in the application.
records.cause: Host key encoding and application input bindings disagree. A shared PTY transport does not imply shared key semantics.
records.remediation: Host adapter can insert a literal newline using negotiated bracketed paste. Verify the draft changes without submitting. Preserve native handling during IME composition and when paste capability is absent.
records.owner: terminal host adapter; application key binding

evidence.scope: Source inspection of MacTerminalView and AppleTerminalView in SwiftTerm 1.16.0
evidence.result: Legacy control-character mapping has no Return case. Enhanced keyboard mode uses a modified Return sequence.

evidence.scope: Codex 0.159.3 default source bindings; no claim for custom bindings or newer releases
evidence.result: Control+Enter is not the default insert-newline binding.

validity.workspace: SwiftTerm and Codex upstream source; Easy Terminal host integration
limitations: Evidence applies to the named versions and default bindings.
Source evidence does not prove current installed runtime behavior.
Candidate workaround requires separate provider and host integration tests.
